tools.name: search_esim_plans
tools.description: Search BuyUKeSIM travel/data eSIM plans for a country. Returns plan name, data amount, validity days, USD price, and package code. Pass a 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. GB, US, TR, JP). Omit country to get popular/featured plans.

tools.name: list_covered_countries
tools.description: List the countries/regions BuyUKeSIM travel eSIM data plans currently cover, with how many plans each has (2-letter ISO codes).

tools.name: get_uk_number_info
tools.description: Get details of the BuyUKeSIM UK Number (+44) eSIM: a real UK mobile line for unlimited incoming SMS and calls (app and service verification codes, WhatsApp, Telegram), no KYC, paid in crypto, instant QR. This is distinct from the travel data eSIM.

tools.name: check_order_status
tools.description: Look up the status of a BuyUKeSIM order using its short lookup/magic code (the code the customer received). Returns only the order status - no personal data, no QR.

tools.name: create_wallet
tools.description: Create a new BuyUKeSIM agent wallet - a prepaid, no-KYC balance an AI agent funds with crypto and spends on eSIMs. Returns an api_key (ak_live_...) and a wallet_code. Save both: pass the api_key as the api_key argument on the wallet tools; the wallet_code lets a human sign back in. Balance can only

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Check the balance of the agent wallet (pass the ak_live_ api key from create_wallet). Returns available USD balance.

tools.name: create_deposit
tools.description: Top up the agent wallet with crypto (pass the ak_live_ api key from create_wallet). Returns a crypto payment address and amount; the balance is credited automatically once the payment confirms on-chain. Minimum $10.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: List the most recent transactions (deposits and purchases) on the agent wallet. Pass the ak_live_ api key from create_wallet.

tools.name: purchase_esim
tools.description: Buy a travel/data eSIM using the agent wallet balance (pass the ak_live_ api key from create_wallet). tools.name: purchase_uk_number
tools.description: Buy a UK +44 Number eSIM (a real UK mobile line for incoming verification SMS and calls) using the agent wallet balance. Deducts about $25 and delivers a QR from stock instantly. Pass the ak_live_ api key from create_wallet. Pass request_id for safe retries. This delivers a real eSIM - only call it

tools.name: get_one_time_code
tools.description: Poll a purchased One-Time Code order for its SMS code. Returns the phone number and, once it arrives, the verification code. Call repeatedly (every few seconds) until phase is code_ready or failed. Pass the ak_live_ api key and the order_id from purchase_one_time_code.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "check_order_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_wallet" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
